order_wins: **Kalpataru Projects International** - announces **new orders and notifications of award totalling about Rs 2,025 crore** across power transmission and distribution, buildings and factories, and oil and gas, in India and abroad _(~8.4% of mcap)_.

**Steamhouse India** - wins a **Rs 311 crore EPC mandate including GST from Himachal Pradesh Bulk Drug Park Infrastructure for a 300 TPH common steam and 30 MW co-generation plant at Una**, with 25 years of O&M after commissioning _(~10.5% of mcap)_.

**Genesys International** - wins a **Rs 283 crore World Bank-funded contract from Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation for a GIS 3D digital twin covering about 625 sq km**, geocoding some 25 lakh properties over two and a half years _(~15.0% of mcap)_.

**YOGI** - receives **two purchase orders worth about Rs 50.63 crore excluding taxes from Companion Vinimay Trading** for machine structure, head, rotary-table and tool-changer assemblies, to deliver in about 15 days _(~7.0% of mcap)_.

**Aastha Spintex** - secures a **non-cancellable order from JSK Textile for about 750 tonnes of greige fabric worth roughly Rs 25 crore excluding GST**, over two years, its stated entry into fabrics _(~6.3% of mcap)_.

**Kay Cee Energy & Infra** - receives a **Rs 21.84 crore Letter of Award including GST from Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Prasaran Nigam** to maintain 220 kV and 132 kV substations and lines in its Ajmer zone _(~22.2% of mcap)_.

**E Factor Experiences** - receives a **Rs 18.58 crore order from the Punjab Heritage & Tourism Promotion Board for an ecotourism experience at the Kanjli wetlands**, with five years of operation and maintenance _(~9.4% of mcap)_.

**Gulf Lloyds (India)** - receives **third-party inspection purchase orders worth about Rs 18.42 crore including GST from Indian Oil-Adani Gas, Sabarmati Gas and other clients**, spread over two years _(~40% of mcap)_.
**Mayasheel Ventures** - receives a **Rs 17.94 crore subcontract including GST from A&T Infracon for precast RCC box culverts in the Jammu sector**, over 12 months _(~23.6% of mcap)_.

**LCC Projects** - **emerges lowest bidder for the Rs 653.34 crore Chhoti Kalisindh irrigation project in Jhalawar, Rajasthan**, a sprinkler-and-solar turnkey EPC job over 36 months; an L-1 declaration, not yet an award _(~15.4% of mcap)_.

**Agni Green Power** - accepts a **Rs 9.14 crore Letter of Acceptance from Mizoram's Power & Electricity Department for a 1.5 MWp grid-connected solar plant at Zoram Medical College**, due by July 2027 _(~30.5% of mcap)_.
**Canarys Automations** - wholly-owned Canarys Corp **wins a USD 780,000 order from Calibo Inc of Michigan for AWS and Azure cloud services and support**, billed over 12 months.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Supreme Engineering** - board proposes **up to 28,09,70,000 shares at Rs 2.60, about Rs 73.05 crore on our arithmetic**, now naming **Ashish Kacholia for 3.20 crore of them** in place of disqualified allottees, subject to shareholder approval.

**Inox Green Energy Services** - **opens a qualified institutions placement and fixes the floor price at Rs 174.36 a share**, reserving a discount of up to 5%, under authority its EGM granted on 13 August.
**Wheels India** - **opens a qualified institutions placement and fixes the floor price at Rs 2,197.10 a share**, under shareholder resolutions of 12 August and 17 September.
**Anondita Medicare** - **withdraws its 8 September nullification letter, restoring its rights issue to 9,58,166 shares aggregating up to Rs 91.03 crore**, and confirms allotment on that basis.
**Bonlon Industries** - receives **in-principle approval from BSE and NSE for a rights issue of fully paid-up shares**; size, price and record date are not yet disclosed.

**Themis Medicare** - **withdraws its proposed preferential issue of 45,95,795 warrants at Rs 102.87 to a promoter-group entity**, saying the working capital it was meant to fund has been arranged by other means.
equity_allotments: **Indiabulls** - allots **51,55,00,000 new convertible warrants at Rs 19.40, about Rs 1,000 crore on our arithmetic, taking Rs 250.02 crore upfront** - to promoter-group Phanes and Hermes, EBISU Global Opportunities Fund and a Nyaasa India sub-fund.

**Imagicaaworld Entertainment** - allots **2,34,82,500 shares at Rs 73.50 on conversion of past warrants**, receiving the balance Rs 129.45 crore of an aggregate Rs 172.60 crore; promoter Malpani Parks converted 1,70,06,800.

**Ramkrishna Forgings** - allots **34,00,000 shares at Rs 588 to Chaitanya Jalan on conversion of past warrants**, on receipt of the balance Rs 149.94 crore, completing a January 2026 preferential issue.

**Kinetic Engineering** - allots **44,51,000 shares at Rs 171 to promoter-group holders on conversion of past warrants, Rs 76.11 crore**, against a balance Rs 57.08 crore it says will fund driveline export capex and its EV-scooter subsidiary.
**PC Jeweller** - allots the **remaining 3,63,62,222 shares to promoter Balram Garg on conversion of past warrants**, against a balance Rs 49.09 crore, lifting promoter holding to 39.10% from 38.88%.

**Affordable Robotic & Automation** - allots **10,93,750 new warrants at Rs 192 to promoter Milind Padole, about Rs 21 crore on our arithmetic, against his unsecured loan**, and converts 8,20,000 of them into shares.

**Encompass Design India** - allots **7,60,000 new shares at Rs 250, Rs 19.00 crore**, the first tranche of a 38,10,000-share preferential issue, to the two non-promoter allottees whose money had arrived.
m_and_a: **Godrej Industries** - **sells 0.50% of associate Godrej Consumer Products in an open-market trade for Rs 450.12 crore**, retaining 23.23% _(~1.2% of mcap)_.

**Dr. Lal PathLabs** - board approves buying **70% of genomics lab SN Genelab for up to Rs 168 crore in cash plus an earn-out capped at Rs 31.5 crore**; the target turned over Rs 57.96 crore in FY26 and closing is due by 30 November.

**R R Kabel** - board approves **buying Usha Martin subsidiary U M Cables' optical-fibre cable business by slump sale for Rs 77 crore**, subject to working-capital adjustments; Usha Martin says the sale sharpens its focus on wire ropes.
**Maithan Alloys** - buys **2,79,000 shares, or 0.24%, of listed ESDS Software Solution on the exchange for Rs 50.19 crore** as a treasury investment, stating no intention to acquire control.
**Cochin Shipyard** - **executes agreements to buy 23% of Dutch ship-design house Conoship International Holding for EUR 2.30 million**, with DIPAM clearance in hand.
**FSN E-Commerce Ventures** - **completes its acquisition of 51% of Aminu Wellness on a fully diluted basis**, making it a subsidiary; the board had approved it on 4 August.

**RPG Life Sciences** - **completes the purchase of the entire stake in Actis Generics** through RPG Active Pharma under the July share purchase agreement, making Actis a subsidiary; value not disclosed in this filing.
**Samvardhana Motherson International** - wholly-owned SMISL **completes the sale of its 26% holding in EPC joint venture AES (India) Engineering to partner T-NET Japan**.

**Minda Corporation** - board approves **selling the 29.5% stake its subsidiary holds in associate EVQ Point Solutions**, consideration to be disclosed at execution, and a China subsidiary with up to USD 1 million of investment.

**Exhicon Events Media Solutions** - signs a **joint venture agreement transferring 35% of its Mohali convention-centre SPV to India Exposition Mart for cash**, keeping 65% of a PPP project with a Rs 75 crore phase-1 cost.
**Quality Foils (India)** - board approves **selling its Hisar flexible-hose line to Ratnamani Metals & Tubes for Rs 5.40 crore**, a unit with 3.15% of revenue, by March 2027 _(~32.6% of mcap)_.
**Hirect** - **sells the residual part of its idle Dehradun plant for Rs 4.50 crore** to two individual buyers unconnected with the promoter group.

**Shanti Overseas (India)** - board approves **selling its whole stake in loss-making material subsidiary Shaan Agro Oils & Extractions for Rs 4,560**, subject to a special resolution; Shaan supplied 51.13% of income.
**Waaree Energies** - board approves the **scheme amalgamating group company Indosolar into Waaree Energies**, putting cell and module manufacturing in one entity.
**Ventive Hospitality** - **NCLT Mumbai directs shareholder and creditor meetings** on the scheme amalgamating three group hospitality companies into it.
**EFC (I)** - issues **NCLT-directed notices for the demerger of wholly-owned EFC Limited's managed-office business into itself**, with no shares issued.
**Privi Speciality Chemicals** - convenes a **27 October shareholders' meeting to approve amalgamating Privi Fine Sciences and Privi Biotechnologies into itself**.
**EMA Partners India** - **files the fast-track scheme merging three wholly-owned subsidiaries into itself** under Section 233.
capex_core: **NGL Fine-Chem** - **commences commercial production of Phase II of its Tarapur greenfield API facility**, a site that has taken Rs 222 crore of investment, Rs 84 crore of it bank-funded _(~12.7% of mcap)_.

**Lemon Tree Hotels** - material subsidiary Fleur Hotels **completes the Rs 120 crore purchase of 989.30 sq m in Bandra (East), Mumbai, to build a hotel**, registering the conveyance disclosed on 18 September.

**Nava** - step-down subsidiary Maamba Solar Energy **commissions a 100 MW solar plant in Zambia and starts evacuating power** under a 20-year purchase agreement with state utility ZESCO for its entire output.

**Interarch Building Solutions** - **starts commercial production at Andhra Pradesh Unit 2 Phase-1, Attivaram, lifting installed capacity to 245,000 tonnes from 221,000 tonnes a year** of heavy structural steel.
**Balaji Amines** - **commissions its rebuilt acetonitrile plant at Unit-III, Solapur, lifting capacity to 1,440 tonnes a month**.
**Maruti Suzuki India** - **commissions a 300 kW green hydrogen electrolyser pilot at Manesar**, blending the hydrogen into natural gas as process fuel, with scale-up planned in Haryana and Gujarat.

**Rajesh Power Services** - shareholders **approve redirecting Rs 25.11 crore of unspent IPO proceeds** from testing equipment, a solar plant and green-hydrogen work **to a battery energy storage facility** _(~1.9% of mcap)_.
business_updates: **Results season** — 36 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
**Balrampur Chini Mills** - is **awarded a Rs 75 crore BioE3 grant by BIRAC** to set up a 100 tonne-a-year PLA co-polymer R&D facility at Kumbhi, where it is also building a commercial PLA plant.

**Piramal Finance** - estimates **IRDAI's 23 September distribution-economics paper, if adopted from April 2027, could cut FY28 return on assets by 18-24 bps**, against about Rs 200 crore of FY26 insurance commission income.
**B.R.Goyal Infrastructure** - reports an **unexecuted order book of Rs 1,720.72 crore at 31 August, up 40% since March**, on Rs 926 crore of new orders taken from April to August.
**Jash Engineering** - its 23 September AGM presentation **projects consolidated revenue of Rs 1,500 crore by FY31**, against Rs 757 crore in FY26.
**H.G. Infra Engineering** - receives the **completion certificate for Package 1 of Delhi's six-lane Urban Extension Road-II**, a Rs 1,393.11 crore NHAI EPC project.
**GACM Technologies** - **appoints AIML Cloud Global Technologies exclusive distributor of its FIRM TALK ERP for 24 months**, splitting revenue 50:50 with a Rs 15 crore minimum guaranteed sale.
**Varun Beverages** - its Zimbabwe subsidiary signs an **exclusive deal to distribute Mondelez South Africa's chocolate, biscuit, candy and gum products in Zimbabwe** from 1 October, with no capex.
**Waaree Energies** - subsidiary Waaree Clean Energy Solutions **is building an ultra-high-purity gases and chemicals plant at Dahej** for semiconductor and solar-cell makers.
**Pine Labs** - commits to **deploy 10 lakh payment soundboxes across India** to push UPI into new markets; the investment amount is not stated.
**FSN E-Commerce Ventures** - Nykaa and **L'Oreal's BOLD fund agree to co-invest in Indian beauty brands, taking minority stakes only**; no fund size is disclosed.
**L&T Technology Services** - **partners industrial-AI firm Cognite**, setting up a Cognite centre of excellence and certifying 50-plus engineers.
**Lemon Tree Hotels** - signs a **licence for a 90-room Lemon Tree Hotel at Patancheru, Telangana**, its eighth property in the state.

**Arkade Developers** - marks two years since listing with **FY26 pre-sales of Rs 901 crore and total income of Rs 828 crore**; its Rs 18,000 crore pipeline value is a projection, not a booked number.
credit_rating_changes: **Spectrum Electrical Industries** - **CRISIL upgrades it to A-/Stable from BBB+/Stable and to A2+ from A2**.
**Megatherm Induction** - **CRISIL upgrades it to BBB+/Stable from BBB/Stable and to A2 from A3+**.
**JNK India** - **CRISIL revises its outlook to Stable from Negative**, reaffirming A- and A2+.
**Aether Industries** - **CRISIL assigns AA-/Stable and A1+**, against the ICRA A+ (Stable) and A1 the company reports as its previous ratings.
**Gravita India** - **ICRA assigns AA(Stable) and A1+ to material subsidiary Rashtriya Metal Industries**.
**Allcargo Global** - **CRISIL rates it A-/Stable long term and A2+ short term**; the intimation does not state the previous levels.
**Go Digit General Insurance** - **CRISIL reaffirms AA- but places it on Rating Watch with Developing Implications**.
**J.G. Chemicals** - **CARE Edge assigns A+/Stable and A1+**, its first ratings from that agency.
distress_risk: **JSW Cement** - receives a **GST show-cause notice proposing Rs 229.85 crore plus interest and a 10% penalty** for April 2022 to March 2024 over classification; it is replying and expects no material impact.
**Zicom Electronic Security Systems** - **NCLT Mumbai approves Advaita Trading's resolution plan** for the company, ending its insolvency process.
**Kalpataru Projects International** - an **appellate GST order upholds Rs 1.45 crore of tax, Rs 0.15 crore of interest and a Rs 1.45 crore penalty** for FY20-FY22; it will appeal further.
**KNR Constructions** - the **Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) deletes a Rs 9.35 crore penalty** for assessment year 2021-22.
**Munjal Showa** - receives **Haryana entry-tax assessment notices totalling Rs 3.27 crore** for 2008-09 to 2014-15, which it calls not maintainable.
**Gandhar Oil Refinery (India)** - a **Nashik court acquits the company and its promoters in a 2014 cheque-dishonour complaint over Rs 3 crore**, the complainant having repeatedly failed to appear.
**Lancor Holdings** - the **Supreme Court dismisses a curative petition** against it over the Menon Eternity commercial property.
**Whirlpool of India** - clarifying a 20% share move, it confirms **Whirlpool Mauritius still intends to sell its stake to a third party as a control transaction**, with more than one counterparty.
**V.L.Infraprojects Limited** — V.L.Infraprojects Limited has informed the Exchange about Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
open_offers: **Mapro Industries Ltd** — Arambhveer Limited open offer (21.81 lakh shares) at Rs 60.13 vs CMP 70.41 (-14.6%); change of control (Reg 4) + >25% acquisition (Reg 3(1)); **DO NOT TENDER - market pays more than the offer**; tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 58 cr
